## Keyboard walkthrough

Required when an interactive component changes.

- [ ] Every control is reachable with Tab and Shift+Tab, in a logical order.
- [ ] Space and Enter activate controls. Arrow keys move inside groups, and Escape closes overlays.
- [ ] The focus ring is always visible, and focus never gets trapped.
- [ ] Checked with `dir="rtl"`: arrow keys move in the visual direction.
